question: Which of the following is a Holy Scriptures related to Buddhism?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripitaka.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tripitaka__**​

 __
 
• The name** "Tripitaka," or "Three Baskets,"** is frequently used to refer to a number of Buddhist scriptures. In English, it is known as the Pali Canon. Sutta Pitaka, Vinaya Pitaka, and Abhidhamma Pitaka are the **three pikas.**
 
• **Theravadin Tripitaka is the only fully surviving Tripitaka in Pali.**
 
• **The Srvstivda Tripitaka is a nearly complete Sanskrit text that has been preserved in Sanskrit, Chinese, and Tibetan.**
 
• **The Abhidhammapitaka's seven books have survived in Chinese translation.**
 
• **In Gandhari, the Dhammaguptakatripitaka is written.**
 
• **The Tripitaka also exists in the Mahasanghika, Mahisasaka, Mlasrvstivda, and Kyapya forms.**
